blogPost.title: The Samvera Community joins the Apereo Foundation

content.value: The Samvera Community is excited to announce our new fiscal sponsor, the

. The Apereo Foundation is a global nonprofit organization with over 25 years of experience advocating for open source software in higher education. They share our commitment to open, community-governed, and sustainable software communities.

The Samvera Community made this change with the full support of Samvera Partners as well as our previous fiscal sponsor, OASIS Open. This new sponsorship arrangement minimizes and simplifies our community overhead costs, ensuring we are maximizing the return on every dollar of contribution to the community.  Apereo will also provide new ways to engage with a broader community of academic open infrastructure.
Apereo is equally excited to learn from our community and the library open source ecosystem. You can
read their full welcome message on the Apereo website

The Samvera Community will continue to have the same governance structure, including an elected Board. The Community Bylaws will soon be updated to reflect the new fiscal sponsor and the changes will be voted on by Samvera Partners.

OASIS Open has been an invaluable resource to the Samvera Community and their support over the past five years has strengthened our governance and operations. We look forward to an equally cooperative relationship with the Apereo Foundation.

openGraphData.og:description: Samvera™ is a vibrant and welcoming community of information and technology professionals who share challenges, build expertise, and create sustainable, best-in-class solutions, making the world’s digital collections accessible now and into the future. Samvera’s suite of repository software tools offers flexible and rich user interfaces tailored to distinct content types on top of a robust back end – giving adopters the best of both worlds.
